pack.title: Glimpse Alpha V2.4.8
pack.summary: Release V2.4.8. 6 change(s) in this update - see the full changelog on the Wiki for details.

launcher.notes: A completely rebuilt interface. Corvus now has a sidebar instead of tabs, and the Home screen shows what it actually knows at a glance — the installed version, the latest one, when it last checked, and the exact folder an update would be written into — with a live view of what it is doing underneath. Settings is a proper settings screen rather than a row of plain controls. Nothing about how updating, Play or Settings work has changed, and your existing settings carry over untouched. Two practical notes: the interface is dark only for now, and the cross-platform jar is considerably larger than before (about 10 MB rather than 1 MB) because the new interface toolkit is bundled inside it — the native installers already included it, so their size barely moved. If you use the jar and would rather not download that each time, the native installer for your system is the better option.
